image_ref.description: Sandbox reference to the source image to be edited. Accepts 'sandbox://<path>' only; raw filesystem paths and external URLs are rejected.

mask_ref.description: Optional sandbox reference to an alpha mask. Transparent pixels mark the region to replace; opaque pixels are preserved. Must match source dimensions; runner rejects mismatches.

prompt.description: Natural-language description of the edit to perform within the (masked) region.

size.description: Output dimensions. Defaults to the source image dimensions when omitted; explicit override re-rasters the output.

n.description: Number of edit variants to return. Each counts as one billed invocation upstream.

images.description: One sandbox reference per edit variant. Originals are preserved; outputs are new sandbox files.

model.description: Concrete DALL-E variant that performed the edit, for receipt citation.

summary: Mask-aware image edit via DALL-E through the frontier-offload proxy; originals untouched, outputs land in the sandbox.
notes: Source images and prompts leave the sandbox for the external model, so each invocation requires human approval. DALL-E edit requires PNG inputs with a transparent-pixel mask; the runner converts JPEGs on entry and rejects masks whose dimensions disagree with the source.
